Subject: A simpler way to track your theatre's props

Hi [Name],

I built Propwicket, an online catalogue made specifically for community theatres. Photograph each prop, assign it a storage location, and mark it checked out when it's in use for a production. Everything lives in one place, and your whole team can add or update records as things move.
